hero.lead: PICHCHRAPA is a film and web-series production house in Lucknow, run by a family of actors. The person who acts here also writes, directs, edits, colour-grades and composes the music.
hero.fine: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. A GST-registered proprietorship firm.

family.title: One family, one unit
paras: A family of actors trained at Indian Films Academy, run by their own teacher. PICHCHRAPA is this family's studio.
What makes it special: the actors are also the writers, the directors, the editors, the DI colourists and the music-makers. At the moment no outside person is brought in for any of the work.
family.why: This platform exists so that after learning acting, no artist has to run from door to door or beg for work. They stand on their own feet, make their own work and show it to the world.
family.creditsNote: No outside person is hired for the work.

adalat.name: Filmy Adalat
adalat.intro: Our first web series. A comedy courtroom where every story is a new case: Husband, Wife and the Other One; Pakhi's Swayamvar; the Jinn's Freedom; the Jija–Saale Divorce.
adalat.pageIntro: Filmy Adalat is PICHCHRAPA's first web series, a courtroom comedy. Every story is a separate case, with its trailer, episodes and making-of kept in one place. Some episodes are also on our other channels; those carry the channel's name.

cases.name: Theme song and behind the scenes

raja.name: Raja Ka Baja
raja.intro: The King and the Minister doing comedy on the streets, stations and markets of Lucknow. One camera, a crowd and a fearless style. A new episode every day, with Shorts in between.
raja.pageIntro: Raja Ka Baja is our daily street-comedy series. The King and the Minister step out onto Lucknow's streets and whatever happens becomes the episode. For a while the series also ran under the name “Sadak Ka Raja”. All episodes are below, newest first.
